title: Bake-off (validators): z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

conflicts: Pool owners (get_owner_id) are a second kind of power not drawn here; the flower draws staked delegations.

mappings.why: Width band encodes the pool's share of epoch stake, compressed 2x.
Bar height is sqrt of the pool's stake share, so big pools stand out without drowning the tail.
Each pool's side is split into its backer classes: other delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, lockups.
Colour by kind of account distinguishes staking pools from other kinds.
Solid outline marks self-declared or verified names; dashed marks inferred; none marks unknown identity.
Largest stake first, clockwise from the top, so the top holders read immediately.

power_means.claim: Power in NEAR staking is delegated stake behind each validating pool; the flower counts each pool's stake in the current epoch.

interpretation.summary: A flower of NEAR's validating pools by their stake in the current epoch (block 222,915,356, 2026-11-03). Each side is one pool, ordered largest first, with the bar split into backer classes: other delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts and lockups. Top 10 pools hold 36.25% of stake; 9 pools reach one-third (Nakamoto), and the tail of 311 pools holds 13.8%.
unknowns: Liquid-staking contracts' own token holders are not listed; who ultimately backs them needs their contract state.
Lockup contract owners were not resolved, so lockup backers are not attributed to people.
The 424 idle pools' delegators were not crawled.
Pool identities in pool-details.near are self-declared, not verified.
Addresses are not people: delegator accounts are not resolved to individuals.

- **What you'll see**: 60 NEAR validating pools, largest first (astro-stakers 5.6%, figment 4.7%, ledgerbyfigment 3.9%…), each bar split into the backers behind it: other delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, lockups. Data as of block 222,915,356 (2026-11-03).
- **Mapping**: height/width = pool's share of epoch stake (fastnear-rpc-validators); segments = backer classes (fastnear-rpc-staking-pool-views, fastnear-rpc-liquid-staking); colour = account kind; outline = identity status; order = largest first.
- **Changed from the default**: `segments: "backers"` and `height: "sqrt"`.
- **Numbers**: top 10 pools hold 36.25% of stake; 9 pools reach one-third (Nakamoto); tail of 311 pools = 13.8%; Gini 0.836.
- **What this can't tell you**: liquid-staking token holders aren't traced through their contracts, lockup owners weren't resolved, 424 idle pools weren't crawled, and .near names are self-declared — addresses aren't people.
